## Standalone Installer

⚠️ **SmartScreen notice:** This installer is not commercially signed. Windows may show a "Windows protected your PC" warning.

### Assets

- `wapp.exe` — Portable executable (unsigned)
- `WApp-Setup-{version}.exe` — Per-user installer (no admin required)
- `WApp-{version}.msix` — Microsoft Store package (if available for this release)
